package sample

func Run(ok bool, input chan int) {
    if ok { println("yes") } else { println("no") }
    for value := 0; value < 1; value++ { println(value) }
    switch ok {
    case true: println("true"); println("again")
    default: println("false")
    }
    select {
    case value := <-input: println(value)
    default: println("empty")
    }
    { println("standalone") }
    if ok {}
    for false {}
    switch {}
    select {}
    {}
}
